title: Permits, Project Financing and Quarterly Results Put U.S. Mining Supply Chains in Focus
summary: US Metal News News Commentary - Gold futures pushed back above $4,000 an ounce in overnight trading on Wednesday, with December gold at $4,033.50, up $93.10 or 2.36%, as of approximately 2:39 a.m. ET, according to CME Group delayed quotes. title: U.S. GoldMining Appoints John DeLucchi to Its Board of Directors to Support Strategic Growth and Advancement of the Whistler Gold-Copper Project, Alaska
summary: U.S. GoldMining Inc. (NASDAQ: USGO) ("U.S. GoldMining" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that its Board of Directors (the "Board") has appointed John DeLucchi as a director of the Company effective as of November 2, 2026. Mr. DeLucchi has also been appointed Chair of the Audit Committee of the Board.
